description: Live run-tool E2E tool list for the Animation Tools extension. Driven by tests/e2e/run_tool_e2e.py from the e2e-godot CI leg against a connected headless editor + a local gamedev-mcp-server. Each entry is one real assertion: a regression in the tool turns the CI leg red.
notes: The editor tools (player-create/library-add/create/add-track/insert-key/get) resolve nodes relative to the edited scene root, so the 'setup' phase opens a scene first via the core godot_mcp 'rql-mutate' tool (editor | call NewScene). animation-defaults is pure-managed and needs no scene. The entries are stateful and run in order against one live editor session: create the player, then a clip, then a track, then a key, then read it all back. The 'expect' substrings are matched against godot-cli's compact --raw JSON, and assert extension-PRODUCED structured fields (Length, LoopMode, QualifiedName, TrackCount, Kind, KeyCount, AnimationCount) rather than the node's GetClass() TypeName, whose casing can differ from the C# binding.
